d:
Bite agast men nyuzlondri ne ek riport ki thi. ismen samne aaya tha ki uttarakhand men matdata suchiyon ke vishesh gahan punrikshan (esaaaeeaar) ke dauran thok phorm-7 aavednon ke zariye matdataon ko nishana banaya ja raha hai.
Rajy ke kaee vidhanasbha kshetron men bhajpa karyakartaon ne hazaron phorm-7 aavedan dakhil kie. inmen zyadatar aapattiyan muslim matdataon ke khilaph thin.
